description: Connect a custom domain (such as links.yourbusiness.com) to one link page on Pro, enabling white-label serving for the link page (/), its blog (/blog) and its media kit (/media-kit). Returns the DNS TXT ownership record (_spica-verify.<domain>) and CNAME target to add before calling links_domain_verify. Refused if another page already holds the domain. Ask the user before changing a live domain.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

domain.description: The custom domain hostname to connect to this link page, such as "links.yourbusiness.com" or "yourbusiness.com" (Pro). No path, port or wildcard.

name: links_domain_set
title: Set a custom domain
